For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://help.vectary.com/llms.txt). This page is also available as [Markdown](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/other/image-to-3d-model.md).

Vectary allows the generation of textured 3D objects using a wide range of popular AI models. The following models are currently available:

- **Hunyuan 3.1**

- **Hunyuan 3**

- **Tripo H3.1**

- **Tripo 2.5**

- **Pixal 3D**

- **Trellis 2**

- **Trellis**

- **Meshy 6**

- **Meshy 5**

- **Rodin 2**


These AI models differ in output quality, polygon count, and generation time.

The process does not require any configuration — simply drag an image onto the canvas and wait some time for the result:

## What can be done after generation[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/other/image-to-3d-model\#what-can-be-done-after-generation)

After generation, a model can be further refined and used in multiple ways:

- Polygon count can be reduced using the [**Simplify**](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/design-mode/deformers/simplify) tool (especially recommended for models generated with `Hunyuan 3`).

- Mesh can be edited in [**Edit Mode**](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/edit-mode), including splitting a single mesh into multiple independent parts.

- Generated textures can be edited, material properties adjusted, and new materials applied - [Materials and Textures](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/materials-and-textures).

- [**Decals**](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/decals) can be applied to the object to add labels, details, or graphic elements.

- Lighting and additional rendering effects can be configured to achieve a more professional visual result - [Light sources](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/design-mode/light-sources) , [Environment](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/environment), [Effects](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/design-process/effects) .

- Result can be previewed in [**AR**](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/project-settings/augmented-reality-webar).

- [Public link](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/sharing-exporting-embedding/sharing)to a 3D viewer with the scene can be generated.

- Project [UI](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/3d-configurator/floating-ui) can be created **,** including [hotspots](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/3d-configurator/hotspots) and annotations for presenting additional information or guiding interaction.


And many-many other workflows and tools available in Vectary can be applied to the generated model.

#### Limitations[Direct link to heading](https://help.vectary.com/documentation/other/image-to-3d-model\#limitations)

Certain plans include GenAI usage limits, defined as a specific number of generations per month. Each generation action reduces the available balance by one. When the limit is reached, GenAI features become unavailable until it resets at the beginning of the next month or is extended by upgrading to a higher plan or contacting the [Sales team](https://www.vectary.com/business-contact/) for a custom solution.

GenAI usage limits can be found in the Studio menu as well as in the Dashboard settings:
